description: Origin airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Forms the route key together with dest; only the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA)

description: Destination airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Includes one unusual route, EWR to LGA, with a single cancelled flight

description: Number of flights observed for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Count of flight records grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Includes cancelled flights; ranges from 1 to 11,262; 10 routes have fewer than 10 flights, so their averages are unstable

description: Average departure delay for flights on the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of dep_delay grouped by origin and destination (NaN values skipped)
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); measured on the same flights as the target and known only after they fly, correlation 0.83 with avg_arr_delay, so do NOT use it as a predictor (data leakage)

description: Average arrival delay for flights on the route, in minutes (target)
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Averages only flights with a recorded arrival delay; missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative means early on average

description: Largest arrival delay of any flight on the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Max of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination (NaN values skipped)
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA; ranges from -22 to 1,272 (JFK to HNL), real extreme delays kept; negative for 4 single-flight routes where the only flight arrived early; measured on the same flights as the target, so do NOT use it as a predictor (data leakage)

description: Average flight distance for the route, in miles
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of distance grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: No missing values and no zero or negative values; distance is fixed per route, so the mean equals the route distance; known before the season, safe predictor

description: Average time in the air for flights on the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of air_time grouped by origin and destination (NaN values skipped)
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); no zero or negative values; averages only flights that flew; strongly tied to avg_distance

description: Full name of the destination airport
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) is not in the airports table

description: Latitude of the destination airport, in decimal degrees
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa (left merge)
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) is not in the airports table; could be filled from an external airport list

description: Longitude of the destination airport, in decimal degrees (negative = west)
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa (left merge)
notes_or_concerns: Missing for the same 7 routes as dest_lat (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT); could be filled from an external airport list
